orthonormality_carrier_definition.residual: Xi_orth(L1,L2)=limsup_x |S_12(x)-n_L delta_{L1,L2} log log x|/(1+log log x)
orthonormality_carrier_definition.normalization_note: n_L is the Selberg diagonal norm constant, expected 1 for primitive functions; it is not the pole order at s=1

diagonal_off_diagonal_components.closure: bounded diagonal remainder and bounded off-diagonal correlations for all primitive pairs

cross_correlation_extension_statement: Beyond per-L RH analogues, the Selberg class has second-order multi-L residuals: coefficient orthogonality, full orthonormality, joint-zero decorrelation, and pairwise/multiway correlation conditions.
